candidate.name: Electrical resistivity imaging data for hydrogeological and geological hazard investigations in Taiwan

staged_protocol.stage_1: Inspect only official landing-page metadata, API metadata, filenames, folder paths, file sizes, format documentation, acquisition summaries, and reuse license.
staged_protocol.stage_2_condition: Before any electrical-response payload access, metadata must establish raw or minimally processed apparent-resistivity observations, electrode geometry sufficient to reconstruct ABMN configurations, line or campaign identity, coordinates or auditable location grouping, and observation-level uncertainty or a defensible likelihood contract.
staged_protocol.stage_2_role_rule: Freeze a group-aware spatial or campaign split and verify a correlation-adjusted upper bound of at least 223 effective test clusters before opening response values.
staged_protocol.abort_condition: Do not access response values when metadata proves the files are inversion products only, the observation contract is incomplete, or the response-blind grouping cannot possibly provide 223 effective test clusters.
